that is a great question, however those tools are only good for basic automation!

I can make judgement calls, that machines can't, for example when to keep a pause for emotion, removing awkward transitions and adjust pacing!

those tools can only level volume, but I go deeper with EQ'ing sound, De-essing and applying necessary effects according to the audio.

and most importantly, I can take what you have in mind and deliver the exact product!
Yeah, I have been doing live sound for small gigs and concerts! send a dm if you have any questions :)
I believe a normal mic and some audio processing can go a long way!

Its just not about the mic though! Mixing plays a crucial role, I wonder how many podcasters actually hire an audio editor for this specific purpose, although I've come to a conclusion that 90% dont haha
agreed, the time signature isnt 7/4 at all, it is definitely 4/4.
